item.title: CVE-2026-130621- Time-of-check time-of-use race condition in the port selection in AWS efs-utils
item.description: [Cloud] AWS Security: Bulletin ID: 2026-186-AWS Publication Date: 11/17/2026 11:00 AM PST Description: A time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition in the local port selection in AWS efs-utils (amazon-efs-utils) before 3.3.5 might allow a user that can start EFS mounts on a shared host to read and write a different Amazon EFS or S3 Files file system that is mounted on that same host, under that mount's IAM identity and access point, via concurrent mount operations. Only file systems mounted on the same host at the same time can be affected. Impacted versions: - amazon-efs-utils < v3.3.5 - aws-efs-csi-driver < v3.5.4 Refer to the article for the most up-to-date and complete information.

item.title: Critical Java Vulnerability Requires Immediate Patching
item.description: [Security] CISA Advisories: Purpose CISA strongly urges organizations to immediately patch the recently disclosed Oracle Java vulnerability CVE-2026-114938 . This critical memory-corruption vulnerability, known as “Java4Shell,” affects the Base64 decoder of the x86-64 HotSpot Java Virtual Machine (JVM), which is part of the Java Development Kit (JDK). Specially crafted Base64 input could crash the JVM and allow for unauthenticated remote code execution. Actions to take CISA urges organizations to take the following actions: Identify affected Java installations. Review your software inventory for JDKs and Java runtimes, including those bundled with third-party applications or included in container images and appliances.
